grh_26dcc867bc0634f84e84.title: The Red Mill
paragraphs: Two comic American adventurers become entangled in a Dutch burgomaster's plans to marry his daughter to a politically useful match even though she loves another man. A scheme involving an impersonation of Sherlock Holmes, a supposedly haunted red mill and a frantic search for the missing girl gives the young lovers time to act. When the burgomaster finally finds his daughter, she calmly announces that the wedding he planned is impossible because she has already married the man she loves. With the romance settled, the Americans turn their thoughts back toward home.

grh_268f1b7d7cd858c28592.title: Pearls of Bohemia
paragraphs: Harry takes a job promoting young American dancer Melody Johnson and discovers she is being followed because she possesses the stolen Pearls of Bohemia. An Italian operative trails her on behalf of their true owner, Count Paul of Bohemia, who wants the gems recovered quietly. On the voyage to Alexandria, Harry learns the Count keeps an imitation duplicate set for public appearances. He swaps the genuine pearls for the convincing copies, arranges for the real jewels to go back to the Count, and sells the duplicate set to the pursuing agent for 2,000 Egyptian pounds. Harry then helps Melody clear her gambling debts and enjoys the proceeds of a trick that lets the Count keep both his pride and his real pearls.

grh_269d3abcf7c94f0691fa.title: Words at War 43-09-30 (16) Battle Hymn of China
paragraphs: A dramatized selection from Agnes Smedley's Battle Hymn of China presents episodes from her years among Chinese soldiers, guerrillas and civilians resisting Japan. She describes wounded men caring for one another, a dangerous night journey through enemy territory, life in guerrilla regions and her friendship with the young orderly Guo-wa, who joins the army partly for the chance to learn. Other scenes show villagers and fighters using patience, deception and local knowledge against occupying troops. The program is structured as eyewitness reportage and closes by presenting China's resistance as part of the wider Allied struggle.

grh_26fbebd7fb3436bab1f4.title: You Cant Ration Love
paragraphs: On a wartime college campus, shy chemistry student Johnny Simpson becomes the subject of a campaign to turn him into a glamorous romantic commodity, complete with slang lessons and girls competing for his attention with ration points. The makeover works so well that Johnny becomes almost too popular, forcing Ann Jordan to admit that her interest in improving him has become love. grh_26b93e8c9558956b1c23.title: Words at War 43-12-07 (26) a Book of War Letters
paragraphs: A Pearl Harbor Day collection of dramatized letters written by servicemen from training camps and battlefronts.
